config.notes: Revision addresses reviewer feedback on address.country ONLY; every other rule is identical to last_approved_config. Country: upper-cased, then regex_extract '^([A-Z .]*[A-Z])$' rejects any value containing digits (e.g. 'WA 6105' -> nothing), trailing punctuation no longer blocks the AU mapping ('Australia.' -> AU), and map_enum passthrough keeps other letter-only country names (ARUBA, SINGAPORE) unchanged. entity.status NOT mapped: no per-row status column and the extract may include revoked charities. entity_type not mapped: suffixes (Incorporated/Ltd/Trust) are name text, not a structured type field. No per-row observation date; fallback to resource last-modified. Address is a business/contact address (Address_Type uniformly 'Business'). One 6-digit Postcode source defect ('139658') fails postcode validation by design.

fields.reason: Column is the register's registered legal name; observations match raw values exactly (e.g. 'UCA - Mt Dromedary Parish', 'The Trustee for the Scott Martyn Foundation'), with only trim/collapse_whitespace applied. Not a trading name.

Correctly kept separate from legal name; observed only where the source is non-null ('Walker Close Community Centre', "Donnybrook Men's Shed Inc."). Multi-value handling is deferred but the one-name-per-source behaviour is consistent with the grain here.

All 11-digit values pass the shape check and the mapping claims checksum validation via the abn op; values are emitted verbatim. Note the roll-up claims ABN may be duplicate/blank, which is acceptable since identity is content-derived, but downstream should not treat ABN as the key.

Emits bare domains ('www.marradhali.com.au') and full URLs ('https://thetransplantnetwork.com.au/') as given; that is a website, though the mixed normalization level is worth flagging as a consistency issue rather than a wrong mapping.

Explicit DD/MM/YYYY parse is correct: '11/10/2023' -> 2023-10-11, '03/12/2012' -> 2012-12-03, '13/11/2016' -> 2016-11-13. Day-first is confirmed by multiple values with day > 12 (e.g. 21/06/2024, 28/04/2020), so no month/day inversion. Date_Organisation_Established correctly not used.

Values are street-line only, not a full address: 'Community Centre' and 'Egan Park' are premises/location names with no street number, and 'Unit 2/18 Mountain View Avenue' drops the locality/state/postcode that address.full implies. It is also the registered 'Business' contact address, which for some rows is a PO box — the rationale acknowledges this but the canonical field does not, so consumers may mistake it for premises. Should be declared as a contact/business postal address or built by concatenating lines + locality + state + postcode.

Correct source column; values are preserved as-is including case ('sunbury', 'DONNYBROOK') and an apparent source typo ('Goowa' for Goolwa). Case normalization is a quality issue, not a semantics error.
Maps to the correct enum; 'SA ' with trailing space correctly normalized to 'SA'. Operation flags (Operates_in_*) correctly excluded in favour of the registered address state.
4-digit AU values passed through, matching the ontology string type; the rejection of the single 6-digit defect is intentional and reasonable.

The map_enum default is null with passthrough true, so unmapped letter-only values are emitted as arbitrary upper-case strings rather than the ontology's country form. Held-out record 2 ('Country' = 'Austria' for a VIC/Altona North charity) produced address.country = 'AUSTRIA' — a plainly wrong country, and a strong signal the source value is a data-entry error (Australian charity, AUS in Operating_Countries). Additionally AUSTRALIA/AUS are mapped to the 2-letter code 'AU' while passthrough countries stay as full names, so the field mixes ISO-2 and names inconsistently. Non-Australian values should be normalized to a country code (or emitted as doubt), and Australia-first reconciliation with Operating_Countries/State should be applied instead of blindly passing through.

missed.reason: Holds clean ISO3 country lists ('AUS') for most rows and is the best evidence for whether the entity is genuinely Australian; useful as corroboration for Country and for detecting the 'Austria' style defect. If a separate operation footprint is not wanted, it at least belongs in the rationale as a cross-check.

Legal names carry reliable legal-form suffixes: 'Incorporated'/'Association Incorporated' (incorporated_association), 'Trust'/'The Trustee for' (trust), 'Pty Ltd' where present (company), 'Aboriginal Corporation' (incorporated_association, ORIC). This is an explicit in-record signal, so entity_type need not stay absent/unknown.

Not a substitute, but the discovery note says values are DD/MM/YYYY-shaped; recording it (or explicitly mapping the date format for it) would let reviewers see the registration-vs-establishment ordering (e.g. Est 05/09/2023 before Reg 11/10/2023) and catch future date-order regressions. Currently listed as unmapped with no home, which is acceptable only if date_registered is the sole date target.

Weak/no true ontology match (size band is not ANZSIC), but it is the only categorical descriptor left with business meaning; flagging because no ANZSIC/industry column exists anywhere in the source, so entity.industry_code is structurally unobtainable for this dataset and should be documented as such rather than silently absent.

No direct target; noted only because '0' responsible persons (Holy Trinity Balaclava) and nulls hint at registration/administration state. Not a valid status source — do not map by guess — but it belongs in the unmapped list (it is currently listed) with the observation that status is entirely unsourced, so entity.status will always be 'unknown'.

critic.summary: The core identity fields are sound: legal_name comes from the explicitly legal-name column and is never conflated with Other_Organisation_Names (trading_name); ABN is checksum-validated and emitted verbatim; date_registered uses an explicit DD/MM/YYYY parse confirmed by day>12 values, so there is no month/day inversion; state/postcode/locality map cleanly (including a trailing-space 'SA ' normalized to SA). Two real problems. First, address.country is wrong: map_enum has default null but passthrough true, so non-Australian letter-only values are emitted as raw upper-case strings — held-out record 2 shows a Victorian charity with Country='Austria' producing address.country='AUSTRIA' — and the AU/AUSRALIA group is normalized to 'AU' while passthrough values stay full names, mixing ISO-2 codes with country names in one field; Operating_Countries ('AUS') is the obvious cross-check and is left unused. Second, address.full is doubtful: it is only the street lines (sometimes a bare premises name like 'Community Centre' or 'Egan Park', sometimes a unit/street with no suburb), derived from a uniformly 'Business' contact address that may be a PO box, yet it is labelled 'full', so postal-vs-premises confusion is not disclosed in the output. Notable structural gaps: entity.entity_type is never emitted despite reliable legal-form suffixes in the legal name (Incorporated / Association Incorporated / Trust / The Trustee for / Aboriginal Corporation), and entity.status and entity.industry_code have no source column at all and should be documented as always unknown. Charity_Size, Date_Organisation_Established, Financial_Year_End and the Operates_in_* flags are correctly left unmapped. Overall: acceptable for legal_name/ABN/dates/state/postcode; fix country normalization and the address.full contract before trusting the address block.

config.notes: Revision after critic review; all three flagged problems addressed. (1) address.country WRONG -> fixed: map_enum now passthrough=false with a full ISO-3166 alpha-2 map, so the field is a consistent code (Australia/Australia./AUS -> AU, Austria -> AT, Singapore -> SG) instead of mixing ISO-2 with raw names; unrecognised values are dropped rather than emitted as a confidently wrong country. The regex_extract still blocks digit-bearing junk ('WA 6105'). (2) entity.website SOME_ERRORS -> fixed: a domain regex extracts the first well-formed URL from prose cells, removing the WEBSITE_INVALID rejection while keeping 816/816 coverage of present values. (3) address.postcode SOME_ERRORS -> retained deliberately: '139658', '80571' and 'Cloverdale' are genuine source defects; dropping them is correct (1-2 rows of ~1179). address.full reclassified as the registered 'Business' contact/postal address, with locality/state/postcode emitted separately for downstream joining, and the rationale no longer implies physical premises. entity.entity_type ADDED from legal-form suffixes (277/478 discovery rows carry a recognised suffix) rather than left absent. entity.status remains unmapped: no status column exists, so it is always unknown by evidence. entity.industry_code documented as structurally unobtainable (no ANZSIC column). Operating_Countries left unmapped but retained as the cross-check that exposed the Country defect.

fields.reason: Column is the ACNC registered legal name; observed values match raw 1:1 (only whitespace normalized, e.g. 'UCA -  Mt Dromedary Parish' -> 'UCA - Mt Dromedary Parish').

Distinct from the legal name and semantically 'other names known by'; held-out rows show proper trading names ('Walker Close Community Centre', 'Donnybrook Men's Shed Inc.'). No trading name was fabricated when the column was null.
Direct ABN column, 11 digits, values passed the checksum step (e.g. 20613885410, 68397437846). No ACN or licence numbers mixed in.

Inferred by suffix regex on the legal name rather than an explicit entity-type column. It works for clear cases (Incorporated/Aboriginal Corporation -> incorporated_association; 'Project 166 Trust' -> trust is plausible), but the source shows real misses and misfires: 'The Trustee for the Scott Martyn Foundation' emits no entity_type at all (the TRUSTEE FOR suffix rule cannot fire because 'Trustee for' is a prefix, and 'Foundation' is unrecognised), and 'Mt Pleasant Public School P&C Association' / 'Walker Close & Brooklyn Hall Association Incorporated' would be classified via suffix only. Suffix-only inference is defensible but entity_type is exactly the field the ontology warns is harmful to guess; also 'Ltd'/'Limited' can be a charity limited by guarantee (a company, ok) but 'Trust'-suffixed names used as parish/business names risk false trust classification. Verify no non-suffix cases are silently dropped where a type is actually known.

Held-out values are clean: bare domains and one full URL, all retained (www.marradhali.com.au, https://empowersportsfound.wixsite.com/mysite, https://thetransplantnetwork.com.au/). No prose/multi-URL contamination appeared, and the regex-extract-first-token fallback is a reasonable de-noising strategy rather than a semantic change.

DD/MM/YYYY confirmed against held-out rows: '11/10/2023' -> 2023-10-11, '13/11/2016' -> 2016-11-13, '24/02/2023' -> 2023-02-24. Day-first is proven by day>12 values, so no month/day swap. Registration_Date is not confused with Date_Organisation_Established (e.g. 03/12/2012 with established 31/12/1889).

Semantically these are the registered contact/'Business' address lines, and the mapping says so, but the emitted value is only the street lines, not a full address: 'Community Centre' and 'Egan Park' are premises names with no street number, and locality/state/postcode are split off. A consumer reading address.full as a deliverable address would be misled; the field name implies completeness it does not have. Either emit locality/state/postcode into address.full or rename/document it explicitly.
Town/City is the locality; values preserved including source typos ('Goowa' for Goolwa) as stated. Case not normalized but that is a cleaning choice, not a semantic error.
Direct state column; 'SA ' trailing space correctly normalized to 'SA'. All held-out states in the ontology enum.
Direct postcode column; held-out values are valid 4-digit AU postcodes (2830, 3025, 3429, 6239, 5118, 2094, 2575, 2546, 4220, 3182, 2330).

The 'Austria'/'AUSTRIA.' -> AT rule converts an obvious source data-entry defect into a confidently wrong canonical country. The held-out row (ABN 68397437846) is a Victorian charity at Altona North VIC 3025 with Operating_Countries='AUS' and Operates_in_VIC='Y' — its Country should be AU, or at most dropped, not emitted as AT. The rationale explicitly defends this as 'now AT, not raw text', which is backwards: emitting AT as a typed, validated ISO code is worse than emitting nothing, because downstream consumers will trust it. Also 'SINGAPORE.' vs 'SINGAPORE' both to SG is fine, but the pattern allows 'AUS'/'AU' which is good; the defect is one rule, not the design.

missed.reason: Not a replacement for the registered-address country, but it is the strongest in-record cross-check for exactly the defect above (AUS for the Victoria/Austria row). At minimum it should be used as a guard: when Country normalises to something inconsistent with Operating_Countries and the state is an AU state, emit nothing or AU rather than the foreign code.

Correctly left unmapped as an ANZSIC/size field — but note the dataset genuinely has no entity.industry_code, so the ontology target entity.industry_code is unobtainable; flagging it here so it is not mistaken for an oversight. No status source column exists either (no deregistration flag in this extract), so entity.status is likewise unobtainable.

Correctly NOT mapped (founding vs registration), and held-out rows confirm they differ (established 31/12/1889 vs registered 03/12/2012). Listing only so the deliberate omission is not later 'fixed' into a wrong mapping.

critic.summary: Core name/identifier/date/address-part mappings are sound: legal_name, trading_name, abn, website, date_registered (DD/MM proven), locality, state, postcode all mean what their target means, and the enrichment columns (purpose and beneficiary flags, tax concession flags, operating-state flags, AC NC size band) are correctly left unmapped — none of them map to an ontology target. Two substantive problems. (1) address.country is wrong in effect: the AUSTRIA->AT rule turns a clear source typo (Victorian charity, Altona North VIC 3025, Operating_Countries=AUS) into a confidently typed AT code; holding the raw value or dropping it would be safer, and Operating_Countries should be used as a consistency guard. (2) entity.entity_type is inferred purely from a legal-form suffix on the legal name and visibly fails the prefix case 'The Trustee for the Scott Martyn Foundation' (emits nothing) while relying on suffix heuristics for 'Association'/'Foundation' names — the ontology warns that guessing entity_type causes downstream harm, so this should be tightened (add the 'Trustee for ...' prefix rule, honour 'ACN/ABN' registration context) or defaulted to unknown. Finally address.full is semantically a street/contact sub-address, not a full deliverable address ('Community Centre', 'Egan Park'), which should be stated in the field contract. No missed ontology sources found: the dataset has no industry code and no status column.

config.notes: Critic fixes applied. (1) address.country: foreign values are NO LONGER emitted. The earlier AT mapping turned an obvious source typo ('Austria' on a Victorian charity whose Operating_Countries is AUS) into a confidently typed wrong code; now only Australian spellings (incl. misspellings AUSTRALIAN/AUSRALIA) map to AU and 'Singapore' to SG, with passthrough=false and default=null so 'Austria', 'VICTORIA' and 'TASMANIA' typed into Country emit nothing. (2) entity.entity_type tightened: added the leading 'The Trustee for ...' prefix rule so trustee names classify as trust, and map_enum has no passthrough so unrecognised names stay unknown instead of being guessed; 'Association'/'Foundation' alone are deliberately not treated as legal forms. (3) address.full documented in-field as street lines of a Business/contact address, NOT a deliverable full address; locality/state/postcode are separate fields to be joined downstream. entity.status and entity.industry_code remain unmapped: this extract has no status and no industry column, so both are structurally unobtainable and should be treated as unknown. Postcode defects ('139658', '80571', 'Cloverdale') are rejected by design.

fields.reason: Charity_Legal_Name 是登记册的法定名称列；全部 12 条 held-out 记录的输出与源值一一对应，仅做了空白规范化，无交易名混入。
Other_Organisation_Names 明确记录其他名称，作为交易名来源合理，两条记录（Walker Close Community Centre、Donnybrook Men's Shed Inc.）输出正确、保留原始标点。
ABN 列直取，11 位数字；抽查 20613885410、68397437846、99009831795 均通过 ABN 加权校验，无伪造或 ACN 混用。

规则依赖名称后缀，只在后缀明确时给值。'Marradhali Aboriginal Corporation'、'Empower Sports Foundation Aboriginal Corporation'、'World Light Charitable Incorporated' 被归为 incorporated_association 尚可接受（ORIC/Incorporated 语汇），但 'World Light Charitable Incorporated' 中的 Incorporated 在澳洲非正式法人后缀，可能是 UK 型担保有限公司；'Project 166 Trust' 类后缀判 trust 合理。真正的问题是规则对 'Association' 单用（如 'Mt Pleasant Public School P&C Association'）不给值，导致同一批数据中同类实体一个给值一个不给，实体类型分布系统性偏斜。建议对无法确定者统一留 unknown 并在文档中声明后缀推断为启发式，或改用第三方法人登记号（ACN 存在与否）交叉判定。

regex_extract 取第一个形似域名的片段，'HTTPS://WWW.ALLMYLINKS.COM/... AND WWW.CHARITYCONSULTANTS.ORG.AU' 这类粘连单元格会静默丢弃其余网址，且首匹配不保证是机构主站；held-out 中 www.marradhali.com.au、https://empowersportsfound.wixsite.com/mysite 等取值正确，但只发一条观测会掩盖多网址事实。建议在清洗前按空白/AND 拆分并逐条 website 校验，或至少保留一条并在 steps 中显式记录丢弃策略。
DD/MM/YYYY 判定有 11/10/2023→2023-10-11、13/11/2016→2016-11-13、28/04/2020 等日>12 的值佐证，日/月未颠倒；且 03/12/2012 与 01/07/2014 的解释与 ACNC 首轮登记批次一致。与 Date_Organisation_Established 明确区分，未混用。

仅拼接街道行，但该地址整体是 Address_Type='Business' 的联系/邮政地址，held-out 中出现 'Egan Park'、'Community Centre' 这类非投递性场所名。映射本身未把 locality/state/postcode 拼入也未声明为可投递完整地址，rationale 虽有说明，但下游若把 address.full 当完整地址使用仍会误导；建议改为 address.full 仅表示街道子地址并在观测中附加地址类型标记，或改名以免与「完整地址」语义冲突。
Town_City 直接对应 suburb/locality；'Goowa'（应为 Goolwa）、'DONNYBROOK'、'sunbury' 原样保留，不做猜测性纠错，符合要求。
'SA ' 带尾空格被规范化为 SA，其余 NSW/VIC/WA/QLD 均正确映射到枚举，未见误判为 OTHER。

映射策略明显偏保守：'Austria'（VIC 机构行，Operating_Countries=AUS）不产生观测，held-out 第 2 条确实无 address.country，避免了把奥地利写进澳洲地址；'australia'、'Australia' 正确归 AU。risk 在于 address.country 的默认值 AU 使缺省与显式 AU 无法区分，且 map_enum 列表中存在 'SINGAPORE'→SG 却缺 'NEW ZEALAND'/'OTHER'，覆盖不对称，但本批未触发错误。
ACNC 登记册只包含在册慈善机构，但源数据无 status 列，映射完全未产出该字段（held-out 所有记录均无 entity.status）。默认留空可接受，但 rationale 未声明「登记册隐含 active 但刻意不推断」，下游可能误读为缺失脏数据。
语料中 ABN 末 9 位常等于 ACN，但映射未从 ABN 派生也未映射任何 ACN 列；若源确无 ACN 列则合理，若存在则遗漏。建议显式记录「ACN 不可得，不从 ABN 派生以避免猜测」。

missed.reason: 该列为 ISO3 运营国（held-out 中 'AUS'、空值），已在 rationale 中当作 Country 列的可信度交叉校验，是最有力的澳洲归属证据。建议在 address.country 无法从 Country 列取得时以它作为次要来源产出 AU（需区分「运营国」与「注册地址国」语义，可在 rationale 说明为兜底）。
当前正确未映射；列出仅确认判断无误——held-out 中 31/12/1889 vs 03/12/2012 证明二者不同，不应回填。
当前正确未映射；'0'（Holy Trinity Balaclava）是未上报而非注销，确认不应作为 status 代理。

critic.summary: 整体映射质量高：legal_name/trading_name 未混淆，ABN 直取且校验通过，日期日/月方向有反证支撑，state/postcode 规范正确，Country 的保守策略成功拦截了 'Austria' 这一典型地域错标。主要保留意见集中在 entity_type 的名称后缀启发式——它对 'Association' 单独出现时拒绝给值、又对 'Aboriginal Corporation'/'Charitable Incorporated' 给值，导致同类实体分布不一致且可能把英国式 Incorporated 误判为澳洲社团，建议统一为 unknown 或引入 ACN/ORIC 等硬证据；Website 的多网址单元格静默丢弃、address.full 仅为街道子地址却在语义上接近「完整地址」也需在文档与下游契约中显式声明。未映射列大多确无本体目标，其中 Operating_Countries 是最值得补作 address.country 的次级证据来源。
